Alterations in the phosphoinositide 3-kinase (PI3K)/AKT/PTEN signaling pathway are a well-recognized mechanism of resistance in hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer (HR+/HER2- mBC). These alterations are present in approximately half of patients with HR+/HER2- mBC. The major alterations in the pathway are somatic mutations in the PIK3CA (40–45%) and AKT1 (5%) genes, and loss-of-function alterations in PTEN (5–10%).
